title: Exact-SKU physical inventory reconciliation projection domain
decision: Implement a pure exact-SKU reconciliation projection over one canonical FOOD-006Q physical-count observation and one validated FOOD-006P recorded-balance result.

inputs.recordedBalance: Exactly one FOOD-006P result whose outcome is validated.
inputs.countObservation: Exactly one canonicalizable FOOD-006Q exact-sku-total physical-count observation.

compatibility: FOOD-006Q SKU id/version must exactly equal FOOD-006P acquisition SKU.
FOOD-006P acquisition, recorded-balance, SKU-balance, read-point and consistency-token SKU id/version must agree.
FOOD-006P recorded cutoff, read-point cutoff/head and token cutoff/head must equal the acquisition exact-SKU evidence head.
No batch-level identity or location inference is introduced.

arithmetic.implementation: Use exact BigInt subtraction and reject a final value outside the signed JavaScript safe-integer range.
arithmetic.negativeRecordedBalance: Preserve canonical negative recorded balances unchanged; do not clamp them.

provenance.countObservation: Canonical FOOD-006Q observation is retained in the result.
provenance.recordedBalanceValidation: The exact validated FOOD-006P value is retained by reference.
provenance.timeBoundary: FOOD-006R does not prove that FOOD-006Q observedAt and the FOOD-006P authoritative database read point represent one atomic instant.

safeClaim: Mechanical exact-SKU reconciliation of one caller-asserted physical-count observation against one recorded physical balance that FOOD-006P validated at an unchanged authoritative exact-SKU evidence generation.
doesNotEstablish: atomic temporal alignment between physical count and database read point
verified physical stock beyond the supplied count assertion
